item.title: MicroVision pushes MOVIA lidar into aerospace
item.summary: MicroVision has launched the MOVIA Air product family, extending its lidar technology into aerospace, defense and commercial drone markets. The range pairs lightweight sensing hardware with optional edge processing and video imaging to give autonomous aerial systems real-time 3D awareness.
